---
from: 4.59.0
until: 4.65.0
---
> **Updating from 4.58 or older? The app's identifier changed in 4.59.**
> GitHuttBr now ships with its own app identifier. Your settings, tokens and repositories stay where they are.
>
> - **If the automatic update fails**, download the latest version from [git.huttbr.com](https://git.huttbr.com) and install it by hand.
> - **If that install fails too**, uninstall the current version first (your settings are kept), then install the new one.
> - **On macOS**, a version before 4.59 cannot update to it by itself: install it once by hand. The first launch may ask for your password so GitHuttBr can read its saved tokens: choose **Always Allow**.
